executive_answers.1_genuine_of_7636: Only a minority are package-ready individual solicitations. ~565 document/detailish shapes; ~912 generic listings; ~1234 forecasts; ~4400+ thin open-data/title rows.
executive_answers.5_complete_verified_packages: 82 reported COMPLETE; ~21 unique remain after removing junk/zero-doc/non-solicitation and applying initial non-IT product filters (human review still advised).
executive_answers.6_why_5471_uncertain: 4119 Socrata/open-data without detail pages; 728 generic listings; thin titles; residual pending targeted work.
executive_answers.7_why_317_failed: Open-data without detail (~111); RAMP/dynamic unusable downloads marked FAILED (~190); network (~9); attachment download issues (~7).
executive_answers.8_software_caused: ≈308/317 are software/config/completeness-path issues, not proven external paywalls.
executive_answers.9_external_restrictions: 58 Mesa 403 proven; RAMP login-oriented pages should count as auth walls.
executive_answers.10_biggest_corrections: Map or exclude NYC/Cook Socrata package targets; RAMP/Mesa platform retrieval; kill false COMPLETE; refine NJ PDF product vs services.
